short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Volt's textbook keeps saying node, branch, loop and mesh. What do they mean?
Watch this circuit. A node is where parts join. A loop is any closed path. A mesh is a loop with nothing inside it, like a window pane.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Five branches, four nodes, two meshes. Learn these words once and every method becomes easy.
